question: Among ISSUED entities incorporated in Luxembourg, which three legal forms are most common, excluding the placeholder codes 8888 and 9999? Give the legal form name and the count.

attempts.sparql:
PREFIX gleif-L1: <https://www.gleif.org/ontology/L1/>
PREFIX gleif-base: <https://www.gleif.org/ontology/Base/>
PREFIX jur: <https://www.gleif.org/data/jurisdiction/>
PREFIX elf: <https://www.gleif.org/data/elf/>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>

SELECT ?legalFormName (COUNT(?e) AS ?count)
WHERE {
  ?e gleif-base:hasLegalJurisdiction jur:LU ;
     gleif-L1:hasLegalForm ?form ;
     gleif-L1:hasRegistrationStatus gleif-L1:ISSUED .
  FILTER(?form != elf:8888 && ?form != elf:9999)
  ?form rdfs:label ?legalFormName .
}
GROUP BY ?legalFormName
ORDER BY DESC(?count)
LIMIT 3
